scientific_integrity: An explicit all-parameter face-pair proof is supplied, supplemented but not replaced by nine exact finite regressions and 21 signed reduced Lefschetz tests. Source comparisons credit previous special cases.
scientific_limitations: Only mixed lengths three and four, with at least one arm of each length and at least three total arms; the explicit collapse is not equivariant. No all-length classification or independent audit. Unindexed equivalent mathematics remains possible.
title: An explicit integral sphere collapse for mixed three- and four-edge multitheta graphs
